At TUDa we dont print Thesis.
The citations at these points are very confusing, why are they here? They should be at the end of a sentence e.g. "This is a sentence [1]."
Sub Research Questions should in itself, be self-explanatory. Therefore don't refer to something from a different question, give all the information required in the question.
Well chosen methods, though too ambitious for the timeline of a thesis.

Not until week 17/24 you mention writing anything for your Thesis - you need to be explicitly mentioning when you want to write which chapter - writing the thesis is crucial and difficult and should not be underestimated.
